# What should you charge for a podcast ad?

> Free podcast sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your average downloads per episode, niche, and read type to get a price range for a pre-roll, mid-roll, and post-roll ad spot — based on commonly cited podcast-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
